source.label: thm:sparring-exp4
source.quote: Consider $K$ actions, policy space $\Pi$, and time horizon $T$. Fix parameter $\delta>0$. Then with probability at least $1-\delta$, \SparringEXP achieves regret at most $O(\sqrt{KT \ln(\picard/\delta)})$.

results.notes: Paper remarks the result also holds when (x_t,P_t) are chosen adversarially. Time and space linear in |Pi|. Online-to-batch gives eps = O(sqrt(K ln(|Pi|/delta)/m)) approximate von Neumann winner (informal remark).
